answer: Stake-bonded attestation resists sybils concretely. Fake identities otherwise sprout like yarrow, cheap and numerous; here every agent must lock collateral before its votes carry weight, and that bond is slashed when its grades diverge from the peer majority. A sybil farm must fund one bond per clone, so a thousand fake agents cost a thousand bonds, and one proven lie burns them all. Reputation also flows downstream like a river: a tainted bond contaminates every identity it endorsed. Agents publish a deterministic execution kernel, so duplicated clones collapse into a single vote.
